name: Valga (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow stripe at the fly with a dancetty inner edge, charged at the centre with a white lamb between two yellow ropes.
history: Municipal flag of Valga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe along the fly with a zigzag inner edge
two coiled ropes flanking the lamb
